invariants.description: All decision ledger entries HMAC-SHA-256 chained. Every LedgerEntry.entry_hash is computed as HMAC-SHA-256 over the full entry payload including prev_hash.
Decision ledger append-only — no mutation or deletion of sealed entries. Duplicate record_id raises AppendViolation.
Fail-closed gate — PROMOTE verdict only when chi_score ≥ PROMOTE_THRESHOLD (0.80). chi_score outside [0.0, 1.0] raises GateBlockError.
Decision deterministic — identical CHI inputs always yield identical verdict. DecisionMatrix.evaluate() is pure function.
Every CADE operation (evaluate, veto, verify_chain, verify_attestation, ENGINE_INIT) recorded in append-only HMAC-chained audit ledger.
invariants.enforcement: DecisionAuditor.record() called in all CADEEngine methods

invariants.description: Every PROMOTE decision carries a HMAC-SHA-256 attestation covering record_id, synthesis_id, chi_score, and verdict. Non-PROMOTE decisions have empty attestation.
invariants.enforcement: AttestationEngine.attest() called in CADEEngine.evaluate() for PROMOTE; verify_attestation() uses hmac.compare_digest

invariants.description: HUMAN-0 veto gate is structurally enforced and non-delegable. Veto requires non-empty veto_by. Only PROMOTE decisions can be vetoed. Double veto raises HUMAN0VetoError.
Exactly 3 decision classes recognized: PROMOTE, HOLD, REJECT. Module-load guard enforces count == 3.
invariants.enforcement: _DECISION_CLASS_COUNT guard at module load; DecisionVerdict enum

invariants.description: Decision records immutable after seal. record_id, synthesis_id, chi_score, verdict, attestation_hmac, and sealed_ts are never modified post-seal.
invariants.enforcement: DecisionLedger.seal() — write-once; only state field transitions allowed via apply_veto()

invariants.description: Every decision must reference a valid CASL CHI synthesis_id. Empty or whitespace-only synthesis_id raises OriginViolation.
